english.title: Undertaker executing street works fail to carry on and complete works with all such dispatch as reasonably practicable
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 66(1) and (2) of the New Road and Street Works Act 1991.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
undertaker of street works involving breaking up / opening street / sewer / drain / tunnel OR
tunnelling / boring under street
fail to carry on and complete works with all such dispatch as is reasonably practicable

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
This offence is only suitable for street works which involve;
(a) breaking up or opening the street, or any sewer, drain or tunnel under it, or
(b) tunnelling or boring under the street,

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
